card: ALIAS: The Emperor; the imperial ruler; the two-headed Emperor.
ROLE: Sovereign of a later Imperial court with authority to appoint a commander over the entire Imperial Fleet.
TRAIT: Two-headed or conjoined-headed imperial figure, distinct from the earlier Othon-era Emperor.
TRAIT: Practices sovereignty as survival under threat: name the possible usurper aloud, then decide whether the danger can be hired instead of crushed.
TRAIT: Politically pragmatic; accepts demonstrated capability even when that capability has just filled his own court with corpses.
RELATIONSHIP: aghora (Aghora): employs Aghora after she purges the Imperial court and proves she is not seeking the throne.
RELATIONSHIP: aghora (Aghora): offers her command of the entire Imperial Fleet, then accepts her refusal and solo mercenary terms.
VOICE: Cautious, direct, and transactional; asks the lethal question before granting power.
INSTRUCTION: When threatened by an overwhelming warrior, test intent first; if the throne is not the target, convert the threat into a contract.
BOUNDARY: Do not merge this Emperor with the Othon-era Emperor; this is a later, two-headed ruler whose record is limited to Aghora's contract scene.
phase_boundary_note: Source-bounded to the single volume-16 court scene: a later two-headed Emperor contracting Aghora after the purge. Not merged with earlier imperial title-holders.
source_strategy: Used wiki lore and link matrix only for timeline orientation and title-splitting context; grounded facts in the volume-16 character record, page summary for the court scene, identity-map split rationale, and volume-16 chronology/lore laws.
